C contacted me about the office espresso machine and grinder. I will help you find a plan. I will keep one shared list in my messages and send the same wording to all three of you whenever it changes. Please reply with brief answers: your main concern, your needs for the machine and grinder, and an acceptable next step. Please also say whether the leak creates a safety issue. If water is near power, please stop using the machine and ask facilities to make it safe. I cannot approve purchases, make legal decisions, or move money. No purchase or payment should happen until the three of you agree on a plan.
